newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares flat, bet on FOMC 'no change' news.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares flat, bet on FOMC 'no change' news.

text.p: Belgian shares were steady in cautious early business on Tuesday as dealers believed the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) Meeting would decide to hold U.S. rates unchanged at its meeting today.
"I believe they will raise rates only in July," one said, adding the 'no change' news would propel share prices to new record levels. "It's not discounted in prices yet," she said.
At 0840 GMT, the Bel-20 index was down 0.02 percent, or 0.46 percent, at 2,239.84 after moving in a tight five-point range.
Drugs and pharmaceuticals firm UCB, market leader in value terms, was up 0.1 percent at 95,650 francs.
Steel wire and cord maker Bekaert was up 1.3 percent at 21,375 francs in what traders said was a continued recovery after being hit recently by a "reduce" recommendation from broker Merrill Lynch.

Holding firm GBL was down 0.4 percent at 5,620 francs. Traders said it was dogged by a bout of profit-taking after its recent rise. It was still at 5,310 francs at the start of the month. "But it's just a pause in the speculation, it will flare up again," one trader said.
